notes.title: Rank Match are here!
notes.notes:
[b]Season 1 Started![/b]

Ranking Trophies
1~100 Bronze
101~300 Silver 
301~500 Gold
501~1000 Platinum

Each win will give you +10 points, Loser will get -5

Report any bugs on Discord Server
Abusing glitch or battling with alts will result to permanent ban in multiplayer matches!

•Rank Match will start on 03/23/2023
•New Item Dream Part "Order of Chronicles"

notes.title: Transfer your progress!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463418/03965c870dbd5526053e48cb68d36e40018f3eda.png[/img]

Transfer your stats and items from your Facebook account / Apple account to your Steam account! But how to transfer? [b]Follow these steps[/b]

[olist]
[*]Email us with our Support email support@stickbrosgame.com
[*]Provide your Facebook ID/Apple ID and your Steam ID
[*]Send proof by logging in marketplace with your Facebook / Apple account and type "This is me SteamID"
[/olist]
To get your Facebook ID/ Apple ID you can click the copy button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463418/ebbafdfc2771b50c52c103510923162ee7baca5f.png[/img]
